dataset: OSIPTEL fixed internet connections using fibre by department
method: Downloaded official PDF via HTTPS, extracted text with pdftotext -layout, parsed all25 department rows, compared sums with printed national totals.
fibre_definition: Conexiones de Internet fijo con fibra óptica; do not relabel FTTH-only.
segment: Residential and commercial combined (no segment breakdown in source table).
units: Active subscription/connection counts, not households, coverage, route length or capacity.
administrative_coverage: 24departments plus Callao. Lima is entire department.
preferred_normalization_for_this_extract: 100 * fibre_connections_2024 / INEI population2024. Label connections per100residents.
not_current_claim: These are December2024 observations, not2026; choose clear date on final map.
revisions: Current PUNKU national Dec2024FTTX revised to2991439 as of2026-08-12; use the consistent2025revision departmental table, not mix national vintages.
